share_keys entries are keyed by itemId (file UUID), not parent folder — file keys do NOT need re-registration after an intra-share move
adoptSharedFolderResult must only be called for the source folder result; calling it for the dest would corrupt sharedFolderTree (dest is re-loaded on next navigateToSubfolder)
sdkCore.moveItem throws 'An item with this name already exists in destination' on collision — no auto-rename logic needed
@internal on ensureFolderLoaded is documentation-only (CipherBoxClient is already exported); call directly from web, no new public alias needed
SharedFolderClient Pick allowlist (shared-folder-projection.ts:28-38) must be extended to include moveInSharedFolder and enumerateSharedSubtree
File IPNS key for re-encryption must come from share_keys keyType:'file-ipns', NOT FilePointer.ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted (owner-wrapped; recipient cannot decrypt it)
Batch move is a web-layer pattern that loops single-item client.moveItem (no dedicated SDK batch method); private MoveDialog already supports an items prop
New SDK public methods land in client.d.ts (class declaration), not index.d.ts (barrel re-export) — index.d.ts is not the right file to check for new method presence
useSharedWriteOps.test.ts already exists — REQ-3 moveItemHandler coverage should extend it, not create a new file

moveItem throws on name collision ('An item with this name already exists in destination') — propagates through runWrite to p.setError; no auto-rename path

share_keys resolution uses k.keyType === 'file' && k.itemId === item.id — parent folder is irrelevant, confirming file keys survive folder moves without re-registration

workflow: GSD plan-phase chain: Research → VALIDATION.md (Nyquist gate) → pattern-mapper → planner (opus) → plan-checker → revision loop until clean pass
Plan-checker first pass typically finds doc-formatting blockers (fixable directly) alongside substantive gaps (e.g., missing unit test coverage for a new handler) — budget one revision round
Sequential wave execution (no worktrees) is preferred for AFK autonomous runs: avoids parallel-worktree merge-base footguns and concurrent test RAM starvation
SDK dist must be rebuilt between waves when a wave adds new public methods — web tsc checks built dist, not source (cross-package dist-staleness gotcha)
Planner subagents cannot commit (gsd-tools not on PATH in subagent context) — orchestrator must commit planning artifacts separately after each spawned subagent
Intel API surface regex extractor may be unpopulated; treat it as optional HINT artifact and rely on RESEARCH.md for verified symbol refs
Scope expansion mid-planning (before planner runs) is low-cost when analog code is confirmed first — update ROADMAP + CONTEXT so the planner picks it up without re-running research
CodeRabbit workflow: CLI review (--agent) before PR creation; CodeRabbit auto-posts GitHub review after PR; /resolve-pr-reviews addresses inline comments post-PR
